svg.title: Robot Learning and Human–Robot Interaction: research overview
svg.desc: Robot Learning & HRI: Robots that learn from people and work with them. Sub-areas: Learning from demonstration (Turning human videos and demonstrations into robot skills.); Reinforcement learning (Policies learned from reward and experience.); Multi-agent systems (Many agents, human or robot, planning and acting together.); Human–robot interaction (Gestures, speech and language for natural interaction.); Robot–robot interaction (Robots sharing tasks and a workspace with each other.); Safe collaboration (Working next to people without putting them at risk.). Open questions: Generalizing from a few demos to new objects; Knowing when the robot is unsure, and asking; Interaction that adapts to each person.
